jobId.description: Id of the job that owns the run.

jobType.description: The type of job that owns the run.

status.description: Status of the current run for the job

handlingFailed.description:
True if the job is about to be set to 'failed' status and we are calling the 'failed' callback or doing
auto recovery.

handleFailedToken.description: Used to keep track of who is calling 'failed' or performing auto recovery to avoid concurrency issues.

remainingAutoRecoveryAttempts.description:
If 'numAutoRecoveryAttempts' was set in the options while starting the job, the remaining number of attempts
available.

startingActionId.description: Action ID for where the Job Run is defined. In this case, this is the asyncRootId of all actions in the job run.
